acceptance: TS, Go and Rust round trips match reference digests; WASM and native expose vsf_ir_validate and ir-validate with identical output; compatible and breaking schema changes are both exercised.

positive.fixture: WASM results equal pinned Rust digests for all valid fixtures and the same codes and paths as native for all 79 invalid and 104 semantic cases

negative.fixture: non-canonical input is a call error, exit 2; invalid documents exit 3; truncated or wrong-ABI modules are refused

security_and_source_permissions: Contracts carry no credentials; documents declare required scopes and authorized contexts, and source-account permissions stay separate from VSF caller authentication.
known_limitations: Go semantic validation uses the persistent native worker op V
